pull_request.title: Add PKCE to the OAuth authorize flow
pull_request.author: farah-n

gate.reason: 2 findings carry a repro test that passes at base and fails at head.

findings.title: verify_pkce() accepts code_challenge_method=plain
findings.body_markdown: OAuth 2.1 requires S256; `verify_pkce()` falls back to comparing the verifier with the challenge when the method is `plain` (line 35), so an intercepted authorization request carries everything needed to redeem the code.

findings.title: Add a regression test for `verify_pkce()`
findings.body_markdown: No test exercises the path in `verify_pkce()` that this change breaks.

findings.title: Annotate the return type of `authorize()`
findings.body_markdown: `authorize()` is the only function in `app/oauth/authorize.py` without a return annotation.

findings.title: Validate the argument to `issue_code()` before it is used
findings.body_markdown: `issue_code()` passes its argument on without checking its shape.
